snippet.title: A Game That Talks About An Indie Developer's Story
snippet.description:
Get Indie Dream on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/612060/Indie_Dream

-Summary-
Indie Dream is an interactive story driven game. Your main goal is to develop indie games inside this indie game. Just relax yourself in this interactive story combined with story-telling, interactions, and minigames.

Follow me on twitter: https://twitter.com/Lorb_Lu
